items.question: Which ten-syllabled mantra formula is assigned to protect the shoulders?
premises: The mantra formula given is klīṃ-glauṃ-klīṃ-śyāmalāṅgāya-namaḥ.
This mantra is specified as ten-syllabled.
The shoulders are named as its protective locus.
items.inference: The ten-syllabled mantra klīṃ-glauṃ-klīṃ-śyāmalāṅgāya-namaḥ is assigned to protect the shoulders.
uncertainties: The verb of protection is carried over from the preceding verse and is not explicitly repeated here.
items.plain_english: The ten-syllabled mantra 'klīṃ-glauṃ-klīṃ-śyāmalāṅgāya-namaḥ' protects the shoulders.
